lines.en: I paddle forward with all four limbs.
Short legs, but they still swing.
This body suits the water far better.
I swim close to the current.
One tail-flick carries me a good distance.
The bank is hard; I can't climb it.
The weeds brush my hide.
I slide along dragging my belly.
My net-patterned hide gleams underwater.
Slow sweeps, no hurry.

lines.zh: 石炭纪的水就是这个温度。
lines.en: Carboniferous water is exactly this warm.
I steer clear of the rapid's mouth.
A twist of my body turns me around.
The shallows are too dry; back to the water.
My four feet are only good for pushing water.
I can still shift through mud.
I work my way along the riverbed.
Don't expect me on land.
I lie still on the bottom.
Only my nostrils break the surface.
When the water moves, my hide ripples.
I'm waiting for fish to come close.
My tail sways slowly.
Hanging here suits me fine.
One slow breath, then little air.
I settle beside a rock crevice.
An insect fell in the water.
My eyes watch upstream.
Limbs splayed, I look like a stone.
The ripples faded; I'll wait longer.
Nobody hurries me down in the silt.
I press down into the silt.
Something touched my tail.

lines.zh: 我伏着，等河水送东西来。
lines.en: I lie still; the river sends things along.
What are you crouching at the bank for?
I tilt my head up at you from the water.

lines.zh: 手指伸进水里，就别想收。
lines.en: Dip a finger in and it stays with me.
Your shadow falls on the water.
I know the sound of your steps.
Let's keep the water between us.
You're thinking about me, aren't you?
My mouth is not small.
The surface ripples; I retreat a bit.
I can't see the world above clearly.
What are you about to throw in?

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我泡在水里。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; I soak below.
My hide is torn open!
I dive for the bottom.
Pain locks my tail.
Stop; I'm sinking away.

lines.zh: 红雾从我皮底下渗出去。
lines.en: A red mist seeps out from under my skin.
My hide is too soft for this.
That one caught my back.
I struggle into the rock gap.
My breath scatters at once.
Remembered; I'll be back.
Is that a fish?
The smell drifts through the water.
Swish it so I can smell it clearly.
I'm not fussy; meat will do.
Drop a bit into the water.
I drift closer, slowly.
Don't wave an empty hand at me.
That smell makes me forget to hide.
Put it under the rock on the bank.
This smells like something living.

lines.zh: 牙全露在外头，你自己掂量。
lines.en: All my teeth are showing; judge for yourself.
In water I snatch faster than on shore.
One step closer and I bite.
Food is scarce in this river.
I circle once to be sure it's safe.
Give it, and I'll remember you.
You bumped my back.
Don't kick about in the water.
My hide is very slippery.
You knocked me off course.
Too close; I'll bite.
Walk the bank, don't crowd the shallows.
My tail caught around you.
That one stirred up the mud.
Move away; I can't breathe.
Don't push me onto dry ground.
The Carboniferous rainy season is here.
I circle through the weeds.
You have those four short legs too?
Let's sink to the riverbed together.
My tail tip brushed yours.
This pool is enough for both of us.
Easy; let's breathe in time first.
I'll wait by the rock crevice.
Your pattern is brighter than mine.
Muddy water is the right time.
This will wedge into the crevice.
I pick up whatever falls.
Bite it and sink.
A bone? I'll keep it to grind my teeth.
The bright chip looks good underwater.
I drag it into the weeds.
Not food, but I'll take it.
Big mouth; it fits.
Whoever dropped it, it's mine.
Hold it gently, don't drop it.
Something entered the water.

lines.zh: 浅水里那道纹，是一条腿。
lines.en: That ripple in the shallows is a leg.
Jaws open, surfacing to bite.
That leg is mine.
Ripples don't lie to me.
Prey in the shallows; perfect.
Locked; I rush at it.
Don't run for the bank.
These jaws can crack bone.
Once you're in the water it's too late.
I close in under the ripples.
I'll come around behind it.
I feel its every move.
Half a block closer.
I flatten my body low.
Waiting for it to lower its head.
Its steps on the bank are getting frantic.
Still as stone, only my eyes move.
This strike must land true.
It backs off; I follow.
Got it!
A whole mouthful of flesh.
I shake my head and tear.
My teeth shut with a dull crack.
This bite lands for twenty-four.
My jaws close and you sink into the mud.
My jaw opens very wide.
I shake my head and plaster you with mud.
Release, then sink to the bottom.
There's a second bite.
I work my way out of the silt.
The water here is deep enough.
The Carboniferous swamp, at last.

lines.zh: 四肢撑了一下，又沉下去。
lines.en: My limbs push once, then I sink.
Mud covers me all over.
So many stones on this riverbed.
I try crawling up the bank.
No good; never mind.
The weeds make good cover.

lines.zh: 一串气泡先浮上来，是我。
lines.en: A string of bubbles comes up first - that's me.

lines.zh: 这水多深，我试一口就知道。
lines.en: One taste tells me how deep this water is.
Does my face scare you?

lines.zh: 岸边的火烤得我皮发紧。
lines.en: The bank fire tightens my hide.
The falls dropped me onto stone.
The water is too foul to breathe.
The blast threw me up out of the water.
An arrow is stuck in my hide.
That force crawls into my bones.
Hunger blurs the riverbed.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身抽紧。
lines.en: Lightning hit the water; my whole body clenches.
There's no bottom; I keep sinking.
